description: This file contains a service class 'CatalogItemViewModelService' that implements the 'ICatalogItemViewModelService' interface. It interacts with a repository of 'CatalogItem' entities to update catalog item details based on view model data.

classes.name: CatalogItemViewModelService
classes.description: A service class responsible for mapping catalog item view models to domain entities and updating them via the repository.

methods.name: UpdateCatalogItem
methods.description: Updates the details of an existing CatalogItem entity based on the provided view model data, ensuring the entity exists and then saving the changes.
